candidates.en: I understand one of the most serious problems is that of light escaping up into the skies above our cities, and the result is we cannot see all the stars that were once visible.
candidates.zh: 据我了解，最严重的问题之一是光线逸散到城市上方的天空，结果使我们无法再看见曾经可见的所有星星。

zh: 据我了解，最严重的问题之一是光线逸散到城市上方的天空，
结果使我们无法再看见曾经可见的所有星星。

candidates.en: That way, we avoid the problem of what is called light trespass, where light escapes from the area, for example, a parking lot, that it is supposed to illuminate and goes, for instance, into nearby windows or roads.
candidates.zh: 这样就能避免所谓的“光侵扰”：光线从本应照亮的区域，比如停车场，逸散到附近窗户或道路等地方。

zh: 这样就能避免所谓的“光侵扰”：
光线从本应照亮的区域，比如停车场，逸散到附近窗户或道路等地方。

candidates.en: For example, if you use lighting, be it security lighting or lighting for your barbecue in the garden, just make sure it is well directed, by which I mean angled downward, and the light source itself, the bulb I mean, has a good cover on it.
candidates.zh: 例如，使用照明时，无论是安保灯，还是花园烧烤用灯，都要确保照射方向合适，也就是向下照；光源本身，我指的是灯泡，也要配有合适的灯罩。
